patterns.title: Human-Friendly Bilingual Guided Playbooks & Clean Cross-Team Handoffs
patterns.standard_playbook: Translate technical setup into clear 4-step interactive checklists (Sign Up -> Build Agent -> Test on Web -> Connect to LINE) with plain English + Thai copy and documented Notion runbooks.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Eliminate unexplained acronyms and raw JSON instructions from customer-facing flows; every operational change updates the canonical Notion checklist without erasing prior records.
